name: Imura Akagi
source:
"Hehe, I can't make magical chocolate like that."

Always ranked high in the "Most Admired Senior" rankings! She has a dignified demeanor and is admired by everyone, but apparently she actually feels more at ease reading books alone in the library. The protagonist, who frequents the library, already seems to have formed a romantic connection with her...!?

[Translated from the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250620154357/https://g.28gou.net/valentinus/#characters]official website[/url]]
